name: Does finish carpentry installation include caulking and filling nail holes?

mainEntity.name: Does finish carpentry installation include caulking and filling nail holes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, quality finish carpentry requires detailed prep work to hide joints and fastenings. Installing trim leaves small holes from pneumatic finish nails, along with fine seam lines at corners, scarfed joints, and wall junctions. A proper finish carpentry service fills nail holes with wood filler, caulks seams along wall edges with paintable acrylic caulk, and sands patched areas smooth before final coats of paint are applied. Because HH Remodeling LLC handles both carpentry and interior painting, our crew completes these finishing steps directly, ensuring clean, professional transitions without leaving prep work for you to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, proper installation includes filling nail holes, caulking wall and miter joints, and sanding smooth to prepare the wood for seamless painting.
